verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file. The closest items are related but different features: an llms.txt documentation index, API Explorer webhook pages, and a docs component that embeds endpoint schemas in guides. None of these shows that a user can download a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
